parsed.name: 是德科技 MXRxx8A 八通道示波器
parsed.description: 一款台式八通道数字示波器，用于采集、显示和分析电子信号波形。适合实验室中的电路调试、时序观察、波形测量和统计分析。
parsed.description_en: A benchtop 8-channel digital oscilloscope for capturing, displaying, and analyzing electronic signal waveforms. It is used in laboratories for circuit debugging, timing observation, waveform measurement, and statistical analysis.

actions.description: 测量并读取波形测量统计信息。
actions.description_en: Measure and read waveform measurement statistics.

actions.description: 自动调整示波器设置以匹配输入信号。
actions.description_en: Automatically adjust oscilloscope settings to match the input signal.
